fx.note: ECB euro reference rates, units per EUR, last observation of each week

ust_par.title: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates (CMT)
ust_par.notes: Par yields, semiannual bond-equivalent basis, read from a monotone convex spline the Treasury fits to on-the-run securities (since Dec 2021; quasi-cubic Hermite spline before).

ust_real.title: Daily Treasury Par Real Yield Curve Rates
ust_real.notes: Real par yields on TIPS at 5, 7, 10, 20 and 30 years.

fed_gsw.provider: Federal Reserve Board (Gurkaynak, Sack and Wright 2007)
fed_gsw.title: The U.S. Treasury Yield Curve: 1961 to the Present (feds200628)
fed_gsw.terms: Fed staff research data, free to use with attribution
fed_gsw.notes: Svensson parameters and continuously compounded zero, par and forward rates fitted to off-the-run Treasuries; staff research product, not an official statistic.

fed_gsw_tips.provider: Federal Reserve Board (Gurkaynak, Sack and Wright 2010)
fed_gsw_tips.title: The TIPS Yield Curve and Inflation Compensation (feds200805)
fed_gsw_tips.terms: Fed staff research data, free to use with attribution
fed_gsw_tips.notes: Real zero-coupon curve and breakeven inflation from TIPS.

nyfed_sofr.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
nyfed_sofr.title: Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR)
nyfed_sofr.terms: NY Fed terms of use; reference rates may be used with attribution
nyfed_sofr.notes: Used as the US funding (repo) rate for carry.

bbk_svensson.title: Term structure of interest rates on listed Federal securities (Svensson method)
bbk_svensson.terms: Bundesbank time series database; free use with source attribution
bbk_svensson.notes: Zero-coupon yields of German Federal securities at residual maturities 0.5-30 years.

ecb_yc.title: Euro area yield curves (Svensson parameters, AAA and all central government bonds)
ecb_yc.terms: ECB data may be reused with attribution

ecb_estr.title: Euro short-term rate (EUR STR)
ecb_estr.terms: ECB data may be reused with attribution

bdf_tec.provider: Banque de France (Webstat), index computed by Euronext
bdf_tec.title: Taux de l'Echeance Constante (TEC) 1-30 years
bdf_tec.terms: Banque de France Webstat; series source Euronext (EUXT)
bdf_tec.notes: French constant-maturity OAT yields: actuarial yields interpolated between the two OATs bracketing each maturity; treated as annual-coupon par yields.

boe_glc.title: UK government liability curves (nominal, real, inflation) and SONIA OIS curve
boe_glc.terms: Bank of England; free use with attribution, no warranty
boe_glc.notes: Spline-based (variable roughness penalty) zero-coupon curves; real and inflation curves from index-linked gilts (1985-); OIS from 2009.

mof_jgb.title: JGB interest rates (constant maturity, 1-40 years)
mof_jgb.terms: MoF Japan website terms (government standard terms of use, compatible with CC BY 4.0)
mof_jgb.notes: Semiannual compound yields of JGBs interpolated to constant maturities; treated as semiannual par yields.

bondspot_fixing.provider: BondSpot S.A. (Treasury BondSpot Poland, GPW group)
bondspot_fixing.title: Fixing obligacji - daily fixing of Polish Treasury bonds
bondspot_fixing.terms: Public website; raw fixings are not redistributed in this repository, only fitted curves
bondspot_fixing.notes: Bid, offer and fixing prices and yields for each fixed-rate Polish government bond (OK/PS/DS/WS lines).

fred_swaps.provider: ICE Benchmark Administration via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
fred_swaps.title: ICE Swap Rates DSWP1-DSWP30 (discontinued 2016)
fred_swaps.terms: ICE data via FRED; historical series no longer updated (ended Oct 2016)
fred_swaps.notes: USD LIBOR swap rates (fixed vs 3m LIBOR, semiannual 30/360) - used for the historical swap-spread study only.

fred_moodys.title: Moody's Seasoned Aaa and Baa Corporate Bond Yields (DAAA, DBAA)
fred_moodys.terms: Moody's data via FRED, attribution required
fred_moodys.notes: Yields on seasoned long-maturity corporate bonds (20+ years).

bis_policy.title: Central bank policy rates (WS_CBPOL)
bis_policy.terms: BIS terms of use: free with attribution
bis_policy.notes: Policy rates of the Fed, ECB, Bank of England, Bank of Japan and National Bank of Poland.

oecd_mei.title: Financial market indicators: 3-month interbank and long-term interest rates
oecd_mei.notes: 3-month interbank rates and long-term (10y) government yields for all six countries.

bis_cpi.title: Consumer prices, long series (WS_LONG_CPI), year-on-year change
bis_cpi.terms: BIS terms of use: free with attribution
bis_cpi.notes: National CPIs compiled by the BIS; used for inflation and ex-post real yields.

ecb_fx.title: Euro foreign exchange reference rates (EXR)
ecb_fx.terms: ECB data may be reused with attribution
ecb_fx.notes: EUR/PLN, EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/JPY for FX volatility and hedged yields.

oecd_eo.title: General government gross debt and net lending (% of GDP)
oecd_eo.notes: Fiscal inputs to the country comparison; latest years are OECD projections.
